elaine: Heads-up — final draft of the v1->v2 migration guide is in PR 4928. Need a quick pass on SDK snippets and the model-swap note. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4928 :eyes:

sam: I can pick up the SDK examples. I already spotted one broken TS snippet (params renamed). I'll push a fix branch.

lina: FYI for model-swap: embeddings changed dims for rwd-embed -> rwd-embed-v2, we should add a compatibility note and a link to the embed-dim migration doc. Quick snippet suggestion: `// old: embedDim 1536 -> new: embedDim 2048`

matt: Updated the TS snippet locally. Replaced `client.models.invoke({ model: 'rwd/text-embed' })` with the v2 call shape. Paste: ```ts
const resp = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rwd/text-embedding-1',
  input: 'hello world'
})
```

noah: Two requests: 1) add fallback mapping section for customers using aliases (how to opt into old alias behavior), 2) note about rate-limit differences on Dedicated vs Hosted. Both are common ask-outs from support.

elaine: Good catches. For the alias fallback, add example JSON for the mapping and a short recommended rollout (canary 10% -> 50% -> full). Keep the guide short — this page is the canonical migration quickstart.

deploy-bot: build triggered for PR 4928 (docs). CI: lint, linkcheck, smoke-tests.

docs-bot: CI status: linkcheck failed on 1 url: https://old-links.redwood.ai/sdk/v1/snippets -> needs redirect to /sdk/migration.

sam: I'll update the redirect and the TS snippet in the same PR. Will also add a changelog entry under "Docs: v1->v2 migration".

matt: heads-up — lint rules want double quotes for JSON in example. Fixing now.

elaine: Owner = @sam. Timeline: get fixes in by EOD, rerun CI, then I'll merge if green. If any blockers, post here and tag me. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
